subject: PLG partner credit issuance — CloudRing promo grant
messages:
From: Sam Park <partner-ops@cloudring.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: [CloudRing] Request: Promo credits for PLG signups

Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well — I’m Sam on the CloudRing partner ops team. We’re scheduling a marketplace co-launch with a set of indie SaaS partners on July 20 and would like to offer a small promotional credit to the first wave of signups that come through the CloudRing listing.

High level ask: Can Redwood issue partner-backed self-serve promo credits (vouchers) that new users can redeem at sign-up? Target program: 200 vouchers at $250 USD equivalent credit (or token-equivalent), valid for new accounts only, expires 180 days after issuance. We’ll distribute codes from the CloudRing marketplace UI.

We can share a CSV of user emails only if needed for invite flows, but we’d prefer a self-serve voucher approach so we don’t have to share PII.

Attachments: cloudring_partner_terms.pdf (partner agreement summary)

Can you confirm process, expected turnaround, and any limits or compliance checks? If there’s a simple approval form we can sign, we’ll get it back fast.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Park | Partner Ops | CloudRing
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: [CloudRing] Request: Promo credits for PLG signups

Team — forwarding CloudRing request. TL;DR: partner wants 200 self-serve vouchers ($250 USD-eq each) for new signups via their marketplace listing. They prefer voucher codes (no PII exchange).

Questions / asks:
- Marissa: do we greenlight a 200x $250 pilot from partner marketing perspective? Any contractual blockers in cloudring_partner_terms.pdf?
- Ben: billing/finance — how do we classify these (marketing credit vs. revenue contra)? Any limits on voucher issuance cadence?
- Vivek: from product/ops — can we generate one-time voucher CSV with prefix CRING2026, set redemption scope to "new_account" only, TTL 180 days, and ensure redemptions are labelled by partner for cost tracking? Any risk to abuse?

I’ve attached a quick approval_form.pdf to capture signatures if needed. Would like to reply to Sam with a decision + operational steps by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: [CloudRing] Request: Promo credits for PLG signups

On Thu, Jul 9, 2026 at 11:05 AM Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding CloudRing request. TL;DR: partner wants 200 self-serve vouchers ($250 USD-eq each) for new signups via their marketplace listing.

I’m supportive of a pilot but recommend we reduce initial exposure: propose 100 vouchers at $200 USD-eq each for the first run. Rationale: reduces financial risk, gives us a smaller cohort to validate acquisition quality. If metrics look good after 2 weeks, we can top up to the full 200.

Operational checklist I propose (owners in parens):
- Generate voucher batch CSV, code prefix CRING26- (Ops: Ben)
- Limit redemption to accounts created via partner listing path (Product: Vivek)
- Add a partner tag on redemptions for reporting (Revenue Ops: Ben)
- Send partner-facing terms (Marketing: Marissa)

Compliance note: cloudring_partner_terms.pdf looks standard; no unusual data sharing required. Ben — please confirm budget approval (marketing credits vs. partnership promotional budget). If budget is OK, I’ll draft a short partner-facing blurb they can use in the marketplace tile.

Marissa
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <partner-ops@cloudring.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: CloudRing pilot — voucher issuance instructions

Hi Sam — thanks for the patience. Good news: Redwood will run a pilot with CloudRing. Summary and next steps below.

Approved pilot: 100 vouchers, $200 USD-equivalent credit each (token conversion handled at redemption), TTL 180 days, new-account-only. Codes are one-time-use and limited to CloudRing marketplace signups.

Operational details (attached): cloudring_voucher_list.csv (100 codes) and approval_form.pdf (signed). We’ve also attached cloudring_partner_terms.pdf as the copy we reviewed.

How to use the CSV: the file contains 100 unique codes (prefix CRING26-). Please upload the CSV to your marketplace promo console and configure the voucher to be redeemable during account creation only. The vouchers are self-serve — users enter the code on the sign-up flow and the credit is applied to their Redwood billing account.

Redemption rules and notes:
- Single-use codes; first-come, first-served.
- Redeemable only on new accounts (we check account creation timestamp + email uniqueness).
- We will tag all redemptions with partner=\"CloudRing\" for reporting on usage and credit cost.
- Abuse detection: redemptions that appear automated or tied to recycled email domains will be flagged and may be clawed back.

API / support links: https://api.redwood.ai/vouchers/redeem (POST) — partner integration not required for self-serve. If you want voucher redemption to auto-apply via your SSO flow, Vivek is happy to scope a short integration (vivek@redwood.com).

Next steps for CloudRing:
1) Upload the CSV to your marketplace promotional dashboard.
2) Confirm upload and send us a screenshot of the promo tile and the distribution start date.
3) If you want the full 200 later, let us know and we’ll top up after a performance check (2 weeks).

Attachments: cloudring_voucher_list.csv (100 codes), approval_form.pdf (signed)

Thanks — looking forward to the launch.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Sam Park <partner-ops@cloudring.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudRing Marketplace <partners@cloudring.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approved: CloudRing pilot — voucher issuance instructions

Thanks Olga (and team) — really appreciate the quick turnaround. We received cloudring_voucher_list.csv and the signed approval. We’ll upload the codes to the marketplace console today and go live with the promo on July 20 as planned.

I’ll share a screenshot of the promo tile once live and confirm distribution counts daily for the first week. If redemption velocity is high we may request the top-up to 200 — I’ll follow the process you outlined.

Sam
Sam Park | Partner Ops | CloudRing
